description: The reference MCP fetch server (URL to markdown). Upstream can reach localhost and internal addresses; activate only behind an egress proxy that blocks them (--proxy-url). Fetched content is data (C-4).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return markdown.

pin.note: C5 is NOT met by upstream: it has no option to block private, loopback or link-local addresses. Activate only with --proxy-url pointing at an egress proxy that refuses them.
